headline: Amman News: The success of the Jordanian-European investment conference is not measured by the opportunities announced but by the investments implemented
summary: Jordan is preparing to host the Jordanian-European Investment Conference, with attention turning to its portfolio of investment opportunities. The article argues that success will depend on investments actually implemented.
why: Foreign direct investment shapes growth, employment, and external financing for emerging economies such as Jordan, which affects its sovereign credit and currency outlook.
